title: See in complete darkness with touch
summary: Stuff Made Here builds a device that lets a blind person perceive their surroundings by touch, using an iPad's lidar and a mechanical tactile display driven by motors. The video walks through the build and the limits he hit.
why: HN admires the maker's engineering and cites it in accessibility discussions, especially for the limits of sensory resolution versus perception.

quote.text: 'Stuff Made Here' made a 12-point display using two motors.
